limitations: This is a public-reference reconciliation, not the accepted-target preflight or an installed-resource census.
Credential contents, public-anchor contents, runtime services and operator identities are not inspected; path/inode metadata is compared only to reject configured credential aliases.
Supplied references cannot resolve independent installation, current authorization, trust acceptance or physical all-copy/nonrollback proof.

supplementalCohortPrerequisites.action: Require an independently accepted EXT-PROTECTION-1 target and real lifecycle/protection installation before the joint cohort.
Reconcile EXT-SECRETS-1 and EXT-HOST-1 to one canonical immutable Platform target or an explicitly accepted compatible layout.
Accept an actual host qualification profile and exact command whose --profile references that profile and whose verifier has a genuine pass path.
Provide the actual accepted joint phase runner and current independently enrolled participant bindings; per-owner local checks cannot implement OQ-5.4-1.
